svg.text: The context / AI layer: seven chains into one search corpus
Seed → staging → prep → hash → (classify ‖ embed) → embedded_classified → knowledge_base. Dashed region is disabled unless ai_functions_enabled = true.
gated: +enabled: var('ai_functions_enabled', false) — real embed()/classify() spend; 23 YAML tests live here
dispatch notes and Slack threads carry no client_id; *_records_meta derives it through these (null where it cannot).
Production today: corpus text is US-era (‘columbus’ in 190 rows, ‘amsterdam’ in 0)
main’s seeds were re-labelled to Europe (a00d85b); the gated layer was not rebuilt in production.
